name: Arduino GIGA R1 WiFi
description: Mega-sized 3.3 V board with dual-core STM32H747 (M7 480 MHz + M4 240 MHz), 16 MB QSPI flash, 8 MB SDRAM, WiFi/BLE, USB host and 76 I/O.
notes: 3.3 V logic only despite the Mega/Due shield layout. The M7 and M4 cores are programmed through Arduino's Mbed OS / Zephyr cores.
USB-A host + USB-C device, 3.5 mm audio jack on DAC0/DAC1/A7, 20-pin Arducam camera connector and MIPI-DSI display pins, ATECC608A secure element.
Wireless is a Murata 1DX (CYW4343W) with a u.FL antenna connector (antenna included); no Ethernet; CAN needs an external transceiver.
Big Arduino ecosystem but the Mbed-based core is heavier than bare-metal STM32 toolchains.
